description: List the scheduled change monitors owned by the calling IP, with latest/next check time, last title or error, and the 5 most recent change events. When to use: after web_monitor_set, poll this instead of re-fetching the page; or to show the user what is currently being watched. Do not use: to create a monitor (web_monitor_set) or to compare one page now (web_diff). Returns: {ok, count, monitors:[{monitor_id,url,interval_minutes,active,created_ts,last_check_ts,next_check_ts,last_title,last_error,webhook_enabled,events_total,recent_events}], note}. Pass monitor_id to get that one monitor plus last_event.diff (the most recent detected change, up to 4000 chars) so you can read what changed without a webhook. Free (not metered); rate-limited to 20 calls/min per IP.

include_diff.description: With monitor_id, include the latest unified diff. Default true.

monitor_id.description: Optional: return this monitor (owned by the calling IP) plus its most recent change diff.

name: web_monitor_list
title: Web Monitor List
